title: Who's driving the Dubai Metro?

facts.said: There is no driver on board. Computers run every train.

sources.name: Gulf News, Inside Dubai Metro's nerve centre

facts.said: Trains talk to the track all the time, and the system sets their speed and position.

sources.name: Gulf News, How technology powers Dubai's transport evolution

facts.said: Each train keeps a moving safe zone of empty track around it.
Stations have glass doors along the platform edge.
A control centre watches the network day and night.

sources.name: Gulf News, Dubai Metro: How 9,000 cameras track 850,000 riders (2025)

facts.said: The control centre is in Al Rashidiya, with about 20 staff per shift.

sources.name: Gulf News, Dubai Metro: How 9,000 cameras track 850,000 riders (2025)

facts.said: One button can suspend the entire service.

sources.name: Khaleej Times, This is how Dubai Metro's driverless trains run like clockwork
Gulf News, Dubai Metro: How 9,000 cameras track 850,000 riders (2025)

facts.said: In 2011 the Red Line set the Guinness record for the longest driverless metro line: 52.1 km.

sources.name: Guinness World Records, Longest driverless metro line

facts.said: Over 750,000 riders on an average day.

sources.name: Dubai Media Office, Dubai Metro marks 15 years (8 Sep 2024)
